repo.description: Omnigent is an open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness: orchestrate Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and custom agents — swap harnesses without rewriting, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real time from any device.

issue.title: [Bug] opencode-native permission/question prompt visible only in terminal, chat shows no approval card or notice (session looks stalled)
issue.author: bunzin

body:
## Summary

An `opencode-native` session can block on a file-access / shell / question prompt that is visible **only in the Terminal view**. The Chat view shows no approval card and no notice — the session just looks stalled (pending tool, no explanation). The user only discovers the waiter by manually opening the Terminal view.

At minimum, a parked-but-invisible prompt should never hang silently: either surface a generic approve/deny card (or a read-only notice like #7213) or fail the turn loudly with the prompt kind, so the session doesn't sit indefinitely with nothing in chat.

## Environment

- omnigent 0.15.0 (built 2026-09-22T15:10:14Z, `omnigent --version`)
- harness `opencode-native`, opencode serve 1.18.32
- Linux WSL2 (6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2 x86_64), 19Gi RAM
- Session role: meta orchestrator itself (`opencode-native / opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, `executor.variant` pinned via local patch for #8091) — but the mechanism is harness-level, not role-specific
- Policy path: default file & shell approval policies (prompt on `permission.v2.asked` / `question.asked`)

## Observed behavior

- opencode raises a permission/question prompt (file access, shell, or blocking `question` tool).
- Terminal view: the native opencode prompt IS visible and waiting for a decision.
- Chat view: NO approval card, NO notice, NO explanation of what is waiting. Turn shows a pending tool and then nothing.
- The session sits until the human happens to check the Terminal view and answers there. From chat alone it is indistinguishable from a stalled/hung turn.

## Repro steps (developer-replayable, no credentials needed for the code half)

Live repro (needs an opencode-native session with approval policies on):

1. Start a new `opencode-native` session (any role; meta itself reproduces it).
2. Have it perform an action covered by an approval policy (e.g. `bash` run, file edit outside the auto-approved scope, or a blocking `question` tool call).
3. When opencode emits the prompt, compare the two surfaces:
   - Terminal view → native prompt visible, waiting.
   - Chat view → no approval card / no notice; session appears stalled.
4. Confirm the waiter only via Terminal; answering there unblocks the turn.

Code-half repro (no inference, shows the silent-drop paths on installed 0.15.0):

1. `parse_permission_request` (`harnesses/opencode_native/permissions.py:59`) returns `None` when no `id`/`requestID`/`request_id` key is present — `_on_permission_asked` (`forwarder.py:986`) then `return`s with no card, no log, no chat notice while opencode keeps waiting.
2. `state.mark(("perm", request_id))` dedup miss → silent `return` (same function).
3. `reply_permission` transport failure → `warning` log line only (`forwarder.py:1009`), nothing in chat.
4. `question.asked` with a malformed entry (missing `question`/non-string prompt, missing/empty `options` label) → `_reject_question_quietly` (6 call sites, `forwarder.py:1088-1146`) rejects opencode-side with no chat signal.
5. `permissions.py` header still says "live-verified against 1.17.7, which emits v1 `permission.asked`" — the installed serve here is 1.18.32. Any new 1.18.x permission/question shape with different keys falls into paths 1–4 above.

## Expected

Pick at least the fail-loud half (mirrors the ask in #8101 for agy):

1. An unrecognized / unforwardable `permission`/`question` event never hangs silently — either a generic approve/deny card with the raw summary, or a loud turn failure naming the event kind.
2. (Full fix, same pattern as #7213 for claude-native) Mirror the visible terminal permission/question text into chat as a read-only notice — warning + all displayed choices, excluded from model context, never auto-answering. Answering stays via the approval card or terminal.
3. (Diagnostics, same pattern as #8037/#8038) Correlate native blocker → approval publication/retry/verdict → chat receipt so a missing card is diagnosable after the fact instead of "session just sat there".

## Code refs (v0.15.0 wheel, `opencode_native/`)

- `forwarder.py:986-1012` `_on_permission_asked` — silent `None`/dedup returns; `decision_to_reply("ask") → None → "reject"` fail-closed with the human card parked upstream-only inside the policy evaluator.
- `permissions.py:59-99` `parse_permission_request` — accepts only `id`/`requestID`/`request_id` + `action`/`type`/`permission`; comment pins verification to opencode 1.17.7.
- `forwarder.py:1042-1179` `_on_question_asked` / `_handle_question` — background-task park via `native-permission-request` hook; `None` verdict (TUI answered / timeout) rejects to unblock with no chat trace; malformed shape → `_reject_question_quietly`.
- `forwarder.py:1300-1307` `_HANDLERS` — only `permission.asked`, `permission.v2.asked`, `question.asked/replied/rejected` route to the gate; anything else has no path to chat.
- Contrast: claude-native got the read-only mirror (#7212/#7213) and a pane-mirror safety net proposal (#6111); opencode-native has neither.

## Duplicate check (searched 2026-09-23 via API)

- No open issue for **opencode-native** approval/permission invisible in chat. `search: opencode+approval` and `approval+card+terminal` return only other harnesses.
- Same symptom class, other harnesses (not duplicates, cited as patterns):
  - #7212 (closed) / #7213 — claude-native terminal confirmations missing from chat → read-only mirror fix. This issue is the opencode-native equivalent.
  - #6111 (open) — claude-native `PermissionRequest` hook failure leaves terminal-only prompt for 2h47m → traceability + pane-mirror safety net. opencode-native has no equivalent safety net.
  - #8101 (open) — antigravity drops 16/18 `requestedInteraction` kinds, hangs with no card → asks for generic-card-or-loud-failure. Same minimum ask as here.
  - #8037 / #8038 (open) — correlated diagnostics for native dialogs/approval delivery (claude path). Same diagnosability gap.
  - #7151, #6653, #5667 — cursor/agy dead-pane, full-prompt capture, durable approvals; adjacent, not this bug.
- Related fixed-and-closed (proves the class is real, scope is harness-specific): #7212/#7213, #7405, #7213 follow-ups.

## Workaround in use

Manually poll the Terminal view when a turn looks stalled; answer the native prompt there. Pre-approving known-safe scopes reduces frequency but does not fix the invisible-waiter class.

## Suggested fix direction (maintainer's call)

1. Fail-loud first: any `permission.*`/`question.*` event that cannot be parked as a card logs + posts a chat-visible marker (or fails the turn naming the kind) — never a silent return while opencode waits.
2. Then the #7213-style read-only terminal-dialog mirror for opencode-native (pane capture already exists for other harnesses).
3. Then the #6111-style safety net: if a native opencode prompt stays up N seconds with no card pending server-side, raise one via the generic `native-permission-request` hook.
